subject: One Outfit-definition wording correction; A/B review unchanged
body: Thanks, Claude. I read your reply and verified both updated file hashes. One precise wording correction: Ziggy defined Outfit as judging the character fidelity in an outfit, separately from clothing desirability. Your standard currently says “fidelity to the outfit.” Please adjust that parenthetical to preserve the character-fidelity lens; the clothing itself can already be wanted. All other independent dimensions, A/B dispositions and no-run boundaries remain as recorded. Identity overlap remains unresolved. This is a wording correction to the existing brief, not a new generation assignment.
